Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued.  See: West Irian: a bibliography / J. van Baal, K.W. Galis & R.M. Koentjaraningrat, Foris Publi

Relief shown by contours, shading, and spot heights. | Some sheets have: Voorlopige uitgave [Provisional edition] | Each sheet has individual title and number. | Titles of provisional and non-provisional editions of the same sheet often differ. | Includes legend. | About 200 of 300 planned sheets were completed by 1962, when the Dutch withdrew from New Guinea, and work was discontinued. series.title: Gouvt. Groote Oost. Res. Molukken (Nieuw-Guinea) Division Great East Residency Moluccas (New Guinea)
series.notes: Topographic map series of Dutch New Guinea (Irian Jaya). Maps originally produced by the Dutch Topografische dienst, and revised and reprined by the Japanese and Allied forces during and immediately after the Second World War. Relief shown by contours, shading or hachures, and spot heights. | Various titles and editions. | "10000 meter modified British grid system" | Some sheets are designated:  "Schetskaart Sketchmap", "Schetkaart", "Sketch Map", or "Provisional Map". | Some sheets are provisional eds., first revisions or second revisions. creator: United States. Army. South West Pacific Area. Base Map Plant.
